title: Equal weight, rebalanced monthly
author: arhancanli
rationale: Puts the same amount in everything and resets it each month. It needs no forecast at all, which makes it a useful plain benchmark for any cleverer way of choosing weights.
risks: It gives small and fragile holdings the same size as large ones. Rebalancing costs money, and the result depends heavily on what is in the universe.
references: DeMiguel, Garlappi and Uppal (2009), Optimal Versus Naive Diversification, Review of Financial Studies
